# Investigation of Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet Investment and Capital Expenditure Expectations

**Mixed**

MSFT revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-06-30 was $245.122 billion [Eed004d4da4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017024087843/0000950170-24-087843-index.html), up from $211.915 billion for 2023-06-30 [E108c50cdc8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017023035122/0000950170-23-035122-index.html). MSFT net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-06-30 was $88.136 billion [E8d5731e201](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017024087843/0000950170-24-087843-index.html), up from $72.361 billion for 2023-06-30 [E5b14d92531](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017023035122/0000950170-23-035122-index.html). MSFT cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-06-30 was $44.477 billion [Ec239d250c2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017024087843/0000950170-24-087843-index.html), up from $28.107 billion for 2023-06-30 [Ed8f17dfdba](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017023035122/0000950170-23-035122-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of March 1, 2023, Microsoft disclosed in its Q2 FY2023 Form 10-Q that it expects capital expenditures to increase in coming years to support cloud growth [Ef9ff8dea97](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000156459023000733/msft-10q_20221231.htm). Amazon stated in its 2022 Form 10-K filed on February 3, 2023, that it expects to continue investments over time with increased spending on technology infrastructure [E9174b902ca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872423000004/amzn-20221231.htm). Alphabet disclosures retrieved for the same window contained no specific forward-looking capital expenditure or investment guidance.

## What happened later

Microsoft annual cash capital spending for the period ending June 30, 2023, was $28,107,000,000, rising from $23,886,000,000 for the period ending June 30, 2022 [Ed8f17dfdba](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017023035122/0000950170-23-035122-index.html) [Ef6582093ea](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000156459022026876/0001564590-22-026876-index.html). Alphabet annual cash capital spending for the period ending December 31, 2023, was $32,251,000,000, rising from $31,485,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2022 [E07c617d17a](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204424000022/0001652044-24-000022-index.html) [E478bf93c31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204423000016/0001652044-23-000016-index.html). Amazon annual cash capital spending data is missing under supported XBRL tags across the evaluated period [E481fbffe6c] [E784b2e78a0].

## The peer test

For Microsoft (fiscal year ending 2024-06-30), annual cash capital spending was $44,477,000,000, rising from $15,441,000,000 for the period ending 2020-06-30 [Ec239d250c2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017024087843/0000950170-24-087843-index.html) [E4ae3721c21](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000156459020034944/0001564590-20-034944-index.html). For Alphabet (fiscal year ending 2024-12-31), annual cash capital spending was $52,535,000,000, rising from $22,281,000,000 for the period ending 2020-12-31 [E4ed40591c0](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204425000014/0001652044-25-000014-index.html) [E4aebf1fb3f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204421000010/0001652044-21-000010-index.html). For Amazon (fiscal year ending 2024-12-31), annual cash capital spending is missing across all periods under supported XBRL tags [E481fbffe6c] [E784b2e78a0], precluding a direct peer capex comparison for Amazon.

## Cross-examination

Management statements regarding expected increases in capital expenditures are qualitative directional expectations rather than verified quantitative forecasts [Ef9ff8dea97](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000156459023000733/msft-10q_20221231.htm) [E9174b902ca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872423000004/amzn-20221231.htm). While Microsoft and Alphabet later reported higher cash capital expenditures, revenue growth figures cannot serve as a substitute or verification for missing capital spending metrics [E481fbffe6c] [E784b2e78a0]. Alphabet lacked explicit forward-looking capex disclosures in the retrieved text, and Amazon lacked structured capex observations [E481fbffe6c].

## Limits

- Amazon annual cash capital spending data is missing under supported XBRL tags for the evaluated period. Alphabet disclosures retrieved contained no specific forward-looking capital expenditure guidance.
